'''Daniel Friedrich Hecht''' (8 July 1777 – 13 March 1833) was a German [[mathematician]] born in [[Sosa, Germany|Sosa]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Biographies/Hecht.html|title = Daniel Hecht - Biography}}</ref> He was a mine manager, then a [[teacher]] and finally a [[professor]] of [[mathematics]]. He is most notable for writing [[high school]] [[textbook]]s on math and [[geometry]]. He died in [[Saxony]].
